scenarios.classification: locked sandbox-policy defect; not externally blocked
scenarios.failure: The approved https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ child frame reaches title YouTube but renders black. The iframe sandbox is 'allow-forms allow-modals allow-popups allow-scripts' and omits allow-same-origin; WebView logs Cache Storage SecurityError and YouTube writeEmbed failures.
scenarios.policyBoundary: Ordinary remote sites are intentionally externalized with zero iframes. The loopback chrome-error://chromewebdata/ state is a transport refusal. The YouTube failure is specifically the app's approved-embed sandbox policy, not an ordinary-site iframe policy or external prerequisite.

scenarios.regressionRecommendation: Add a focused official-native BrowserPanel test that requires visible youtube-nocookie player content and zero sandbox-origin/cache errors; security-review the minimum sandbox change needed for the privacy embed, including whether allow-same-origin is acceptable for this cross-origin allowlist.
